title: A Survey of Frontiers in LLM Reasoning: Inference Scaling, Learning to Reason, and Agentic Systems
best_for_zh: 选择推理数据、训练、测试时计算或智能体设计的读者。
one_line: A TMLR survey that maps reasoning by when it is achieved and which system components perform it.
按实现阶段和系统架构组织大模型推理前沿的 TMLR 2025 综述。
why: It prevents data, training, inference, and agent design from being compared as if they were the same intervention.
inclusion_reason: A TMLR 2025 survey from Salesforce AI Research, NUS, NTU, and A*STAR that connects reasoning data, training, inference, and agentic systems.

title: Problem
问题
html: Reasoning research mixes changes made during training with changes made while answering, and it mixes a single model with systems that use tools or other agents. This survey makes those differences explicit. It studies prompts, traces, feedback, tools, and benchmarks as parts of a system rather than as interchangeable improvements.
推理研究常把训练阶段的改变同作答阶段的改变混在一起，也常把单模型同使用工具或其他智能体的系统混在一起。这篇综述把这些差异明确化：把提示、过程、反馈、工具和基准看作系统部件，而不是可互换的提升。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: Its map crosses two axes. Regime says whether reasoning is obtained at inference time or learned through training. Architecture says whether reasoning belongs to one LLM, a tool-using agent, or multiple agents. Each cell can then be studied at the input level and output level. This prevents comparing extra search with better training data as though they had identical costs and evidence.
它的地图交叉两个轴。Regime 指推理是在测试时获得，还是通过训练学得；Architecture 指推理由单个 LLM、会用工具的智能体还是多个智能体完成。每个格子还能从输入层和输出层研究。这样就不会把额外搜索和更好训练数据当成成本与证据相同的手段。

title: Method
方法
html: The method is a literature classification. For a cited system, first state its regime and architecture. Then record the prompt or retrieved input, generated candidates or trajectories, feedback source, external tools, and final evaluator. This small record is enough to expose whether a reported gain follows from learned parameters, more test-time attempts, stronger tools, or collaboration.
方法是文献分类。面对一个被引用系统，先写出它的 regime 和 architecture；再记录提示或检索输入、生成候选或轨迹、反馈来源、外部工具和最终评测器。这张小记录足以看出提升来自已学参数、更多测试时尝试、更强工具还是协作。

title: Evidence
证据
html: The official TMLR abstract states the two dimensions and covers supervised learning, reinforcement learning, reasoners, verifiers, and agentic workflows. It supports a field map, not one global performance ranking. Recover the original task and tool contract before comparing two entries that happen to share a reasoning label.
官方 TMLR 摘要说明两条维度，并覆盖监督学习、强化学习、推理器、验证器和智能体流程。它支持领域地图，不支持全球统一性能排名。比较两个同样带“推理”标签的条目前，应找回原始任务和工具约定。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Earlier surveys commonly divided papers by technique names. This one makes stage and system boundary the first comparison. That matters because a trace collected for training, a trace sampled repeatedly at inference, and a multi-agent conversation may look similar in text while being different data objects with different reproducibility requirements.
较早综述常按技术名称划分论文；这篇先看实现阶段和系统边界。它很重要，因为用于训练的过程、测试时反复采样的过程和多智能体对话在文本上可能相似，却是不同数据对象，有不同可复现要求。

title: Limitations
局限
html: The taxonomy is broad and cannot replace task-specific reporting. Agent results in particular depend on tool quality, environment state, action limits, and interaction budget. A system may appear stronger simply because it is allowed more observations or retries. Use the map to form comparisons, then read the primary protocol.
分类很广，不能替代任务特定报告。尤其智能体结果依赖工具质量、环境状态、动作限制和交互预算；系统可能只是因获得更多观察或重试而显得更强。先用地图形成比较，再读原始协议。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use this survey when a project has several possible levers. If the failure is missing knowledge, retrieval may be relevant; if the failure is a long dependency chain, more candidates or training traces may be relevant; if the task requires action, the environment and feedback must be specified. The framework turns “improve reasoning” into a concrete design choice.
当项目有多个可能杠杆时可用这篇综述。若失败来自缺知识，检索可能相关；若来自长依赖链，更多候选或训练过程可能相关；若任务需要行动，就必须写清环境和反馈。框架把“提升推理”变成具体设计选择。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: Read the two axes first, then place one familiar paper in a cell. Ask what it changes at input time and output time, and who or what judges success. Keep a separate note for fixed learned behavior and added test-time computation. This makes later comparisons much less misleading.
先读两条轴，再把一篇熟悉论文放进一个格子。问它在输入和输出阶段改变什么，以及谁或什么判定成功。把固定学得的行为和新增测试时计算分开记。这会让之后比较少很多误导。
